' REQ: LANG-411 LANG-412 LANG-413 LANG-414 LANG-415 Imports System Namespace Demo Public Class Greeter Private ReadOnly _name As String Public Sub New(ByVal name As String) _name = name End Sub REM Greets the name. Public Function Greet(ByVal times As Integer) As String Dim text As String = "Hello, " & _name & "! ""quoted""" Dim result As String = "" For i As Integer = 1 To times result &= text & vbCrLf Next If times > 0 AndAlso Not String.IsNullOrEmpty(_name) Then Return result Else Return Nothing End If End Function End Class Module Program Sub Main() Dim g As New Greeter("world") Console.WriteLine(g.Greet(2) & CStr(&H1F + 1.5) & True) End Sub End Module End Namespace
